**Observation Log:**

[FACT] User feels overwhelmed with online shopping habits and needs help tracking expenses.  
[EVENT] User has been making at least one online purchase every week, sometimes two or three, since last month.  
[CHANGE] User acknowledges that their online shopping habits are getting out of hand.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant acknowledges the user's recognition of the issue and willingness to make a change as a positive first step.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggests starting a spending journal to track online purchases, including date, item, price, and website/store.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommends using a budgeting app like Mint, You Need a Budget (YNAB), or Personal Capital to track expenses.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant advises setting a budget for online shopping each month and sticking to it.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggests implementing a 30-day rule before making online purchases to determine necessity.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommends unsubscribing from promotional emails to reduce temptation to shop.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant advises removing saved credit card information from online retailers to make impulse purchases more difficult.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant encourages finding alternative ways to cope with feelings that lead to shopping, such as exercise or hobbies.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggests setting boundaries for online shopping, like limiting it to certain days of the week.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommends a 'one in, one out' policy for purchases to maintain balance.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant emphasizes the importance of regularly reviewing spending and making adjustments as needed.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant reassures the user that developing new habits takes time and effort.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provides an overview of Mint, YNAB, and Personal Capital, detailing their features and costs.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant describes Mint as free, user-friendly, and capable of linking to bank accounts and credit cards for tracking spending.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant explains that Mint categorizes transactions automatically and offers budgeting tools.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant outlines Mint's security measures, including 128-bit SSL encryption and two-factor authentication.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant details how Mint links to bank accounts and gathers transaction data for tracking.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant explains that Mint provides alerts for large transactions and allows users to set budgets for categories.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant encourages the user to monitor their accounts regularly for suspicious activity.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant confirms that Mint can help the user track their spending and identify areas for improvement.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID
